'''Jody Shields''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 5th at [[May 2001 Meriden tournament]] on 12 May 2001, according to Keith Henderson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2314">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-16-meriden-ct-5-12-01-cpa-auditd2314/ meriden-ct-5-12-01-cpa-audit], DeckTech (Keith "Tessek-CPA" Henderson, 16 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-16-meriden-ct-5-12-01-cpa-auditd2314/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
